Kanira

The Sovereign Bridal Edit

Kanira resurrects the regal splendour of the Mughal courts. Each creation marries untreated Colombian and Zambian emerald cabochons with Syndicate uncut diamonds, set into hand-engraved 22-karat yellow gold frames featuring intricate reverse meenakari.

Metal Purity 22K Gold (916)
Gemstones Syndicate Polki & Emeralds

Amora

The Modern Solitaire Symphony

Dedicated to singular diamond brilliance, Amora presents D-F color, flawless and VVS clarity solitaires certified by IGI and SGL. Cut with exacting mathematical proportions, each stone is mounted in featherweight 18-karat sovereign white and rose gold.

Diamond Grade Triple Excellent Cut

Collection 03

Velare

Woven Whispers of Gold

Velare explores sculptural, fluid gold. Inspired by the undulating rivers and valleys of Jammu and Kashmir, gold is drawn into fine wire filigree, woven into delicate mesh textures, and polished to a mirror gleam that drapes seamlessly against the collarbone.

Artisan Technique Hand-drawn Wire Filigree
Finish High Satin & Mirror Polish
Wearability Articulated Comfort Fit

Our Heritage Story

Four Decades of Regal Craftsmanship

Founded in 1986 in the historic heart of Jammu by Mr. Ajay Talla, our atelier was born with a singular conviction: to preserve the dying arts of royal Dogra and Mughal goldsmithing.

Over the last 40 years, that intimate boutique has blossomed into Jammu & Kashmir's premier high jewellery house, revered by over 2,15,000 patrons spanning three generations. Here, ancestral techniques survive uncorrupted by industrial compromise.

1986
Inauguration of the foundational atelier at Lakhdatta Bazar, Jammu.
2002
Pioneered certified natural diamond jewellery and strict BIS hallmarking in North India.
2014
Unveiled the multi-storey Flagship Luxury Mansion at Channi Himmat, Jammu.
2021
Launched ZAVI by Talla, modern 925 sterling silver for contemporary self-expression.
2026
Celebrating our 40th Jubilee Anniversary with the royal Kanira & Amora edits.
